entities.name: Our Lady of the Assumption Church, Novocherkassk

entities.summary: The Our Lady of the Assumption Church is a Catholic church in the city of Novocherkassk in Russia. It depends on the deanship of Rostov in the Diocese of Saint Clement at Saratov.
